title: [Bug] Skills discovery fails when 'description' in SKILL.md frontmatter is a single line

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report is clear, complete, and provides specific reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, and environment details for a bug in skill frontmatter discovery.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue is a localized parsing fix in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.ts to correctly handle single-line description frontmatter values in SKILL.md files, along with unit tests in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.test.ts.

summary.problem: Skill discovery fails when the description field in SKILL.md frontmatter is written as a single line.
summary.root_cause: The frontmatter parser in skillLoader.ts relies on js-yaml load() and falls back to parseSimpleFrontmatter() when YAML parsing fails. When a single-line description contains unquoted YAML special characters (like colons or punctuation) or quotes, js-yaml fails. Additionally, parseSimpleFrontmatter does not strip quotes or correctly parse single-line vs multi-line frontmatter values with special characters.
summary.context: In SKILL.md files, skills specify frontmatter enclosed by '---' delimiters. Multi-line scalar block descriptions (using '>') pass YAML parsing easily, but single-line descriptions frequently fail js-yaml parsing if special characters or colons are present without surrounding quotes, triggering fallback logic that fails to extract valid name/description fields or leaves formatting artifacts.

steps: Update parseFrontmatter and parseSimpleFrontmatter in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.ts to robustly handle both single-line and multi-line frontmatter descriptions in SKILL.md files.
Ensure parseSimpleFrontmatter properly strips quotes around scalar values and correctly extracts single-line description fields even when YAML load fails.
Ensure parseFrontmatter handles edge cases where description strings contain special YAML characters, colons, or line breaks without throwing uncaught errors or failing fallback parsing.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Skills with single-line descriptions in SKILL.md frontmatter (with or without colons/punctuation) are successfully parsed and discovered.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.test.ts testing SKILL.md files with single-line descriptions containing various punctuation, colons, and single/double quotes.
Run 'npm test' or 'npx vitest run packages/core/src/skills/skillLoader.test.ts' to verify that all frontmatter parsing tests pass.
